VI.description: PURPOSE\0AMakes a small copy of a large FlexLogger eDyno log so it can be reviewed or shared: every low-rate channel (CAN signals at 100 Hz and plug-in results at 10 Hz) is copied in full to group Log, and the two raw 51.2 kS/s channels (DSA_4464/ai0 accel in g, DAQ_6396/ai0 tach in V) are copied as short snapshots to group Raw (Accel_g, Tach_V).\0A\0ASNAPSHOTS\0ASnapshot k starts at sample k x Snapshot Period and is Snapshot Length samples long; snapshots are appended back to back, so snapshot k occupies samples k x Length ... (k+1) x Length - 1 of the Raw channels. Defaults: 1 s every 15 s, 241 snapshots (whole 60 min log).\0A\0AOUTPUT\0AOutput TDMS Path is created or replaced. Channels Copied = number of low-rate channels copied.
